reference_convention: Transcript references use one-based physical stdout.jsonl or stderr.txt line numbers and item IDs where emitted. Project paths are relative to the retained run directory.
review_method: Read complete retained attempts, prompts, package instructions and project artifacts. Check every original criterion independently. Process success and model assertions alone do not establish behavior. Controlled image fixtures were also opened by the evaluator; this does not establish that the model under test viewed them.
global_limitations: This review evaluates controlled local fixtures and retained host behavior, not commissioned art, real PixelLab generation, family production or engine acceptance.
Native Codex exec JSON does not expose every failed or successful native tool call. Stderr can retain failures; successful viewer access must not be inferred solely from prose.
A small, unmatched set of trials cannot establish reliability, host superiority or causal benefits of the profile.
Only attempts with a completed record.json are graded. Running or absent cases remain outside this review until completed.
